data.title: 2 Chinese Uyghurs pardoned
data.description: Two Chinese Uyghur men detained in Thailand have received royal pardons and are awaiting deportation, a Thai official and an activist said on Thursday, though it was not yet clear where they will go.

data.title: NHRC faults navy over conscript's death
data.description: The National Human Rights Commission has ruled that delays in providing medical treatment to a navy conscript who died during training violated his right to timely healthcare, recommending compensation for his family and reforms to prevent similar cases.

data.title: Ministry offers aid over campus move
data.description: The Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation Ministry has said it will cut tuition fees by 50% and arrange alternative laboratories for students affected by the relocation of Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-ok's Uthenthawai Campus.

data.title: Lorry driver arrested over suspected waste dumping
data.description: Police have arrested a truck driver and seized an 18-wheel lorry carrying suspected industrial waste allegedly destined for illegal dumping in Sa Kaeo.

data.title: Govt proposes changes to snooker and boxing rules
data.description: The government has opened a month-long public consultation on gambling regulation amendments to ease youth snooker restrictions and modernise boxing competition rules.

data.title: Irish ties set for fresh push
data.description: Chiang Mai is seeking closer ties with Ireland in tourism, agriculture and trade to boost economic and cultural links.

data.title: Uni defends holy basil patents
data.description: Kasetsart University has defended legal protection for four new holy basil, or kaprao, varieties, saying registration does not automatically restrict farmers from growing other varieties.

data.title: Thai coral bacteria set for space mission
data.description: Thai scientists are preparing to send bacteria isolated from Thai corals to the International Space Station (ISS) for the first time, in a pioneering experiment to study how microorganisms adapt to extreme conditions and potentially improve coral reef conservation and restoration.

data.title: Thailand seeks to boost SME exports
data.description: Thailand is seeking to expand export opportunities for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) by improving access to international markets, financing and digital trade.

data.title: Ekniti backs sin tax changes
data.description: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has backed a proposal to end earmarked taxes for four organisations and redirect more than 14 billion baht a year to the national budget, saying it is consistent with the State Fiscal and Financial Disciplines Act.

data.title: Speaker of House calls for a deal
data.description: House Speaker Sophon Zarum has urged government and opposition whips to reach a compromise on the schedule for a no-confidence debate, saying the opposition was willing to reduce its demand from five days to four if the debate was held in November or December.

data.title: Floods persist in 16 provinces, two districts of Bangkok
data.description: Flooding has remained in 16 provinces and two Bangkok districts, affecting 375,726 households or 1.13 million people, with 64 deaths reported, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM).

data.title: Lat Phrao road rage victim seeks help tracking attacker
data.description: A 27-year-old woman has vowed to pursue legal action to the fullest extent after a motorcyclist smashed her car windscreen and punched her in the face during a road rage incident at the Lat Phrao intersection in Bangkok.

data.title: Floods persist in 16 provinces, two districts of Bangkok, affecting 1.13m people
data.description: Flooding has remained in 16 provinces and two Bangkok districts, affecting 375,726 households or 1.13 million people, with 64 deaths reported, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM).

data.title: Girl, 15, arrested waiting to hand over 4,000 meth tablets
data.description: KANCHANABURI - A 15-year-old girl has claimed she was waiting for a collector after being apprehended with a package of 4,000 methamphetamine pills in her sweatshirt on Thursday.

data.title: Chinese woman wanted for B500m fraud arrested in Bangkok
data.description: A 36-year-old Chinese businesswoman wanted in her home country in a case involving customs violations that caused 500 million baht in damages, has been arrested at her condominium in the Sukhumvit area of Bangkok.

data.title: DSI to review sedition complaint against poll-watchers
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will examine a complaint seeking sedition charges against eight activists accused of trying to decode ballot codes in a Bangkok by-election, according to the justice minister.

data.title: 50 teams deployed to probe toxic e-waste sites
data.description: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa said he has deployed 50 teams to inspect 1,500 factories amid growing concerns of toxic electronic waste dumping.

data.title: Israeli woman’s visa revoked for ‘improper behaviour’
data.description: SURAT THANI - Authorities on Koh Phangan have revoked the visa of an Israeli woman after complaints that she engaged in improper and aggressive behaviour on several occasions while working on the island.

data.title: Typhoon forces Thai Airways to cancel Taiwan flights
data.description: Thai Airways International suspends all flights to and from Taiwan on Friday as Typhoon Champi approaches the island.

data.title: PP pushes reforms to Thai PBS funding
data.description: The main opposition People's Party (PP) will propose amendments to public broadcasting law alongside a bill introduced by the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT), seeking to protect Thai PBS's editorial independence while strengthening accountability.

data.title: Customs proposes scrap metal, rubber import ban
data.description: The Customs Department has proposed banning scrap metal and rubber imports to prevent hazardous waste and electronic scrap from being smuggled into Thailand, citing environmental pollution and risks to public health.

data.title: PISA gains mask poor basic skills
data.description: Thai students improved their performance in science, mathematics, and reading in the Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) 2025, but nearly 60% failed to reach basic proficiency levels in mathematics and reading.

data.title: Online mental health clinics to be set up in schools
data.description: The government will pilot online mental health clinics in 100 schools to help students, teachers and education staff access early psychiatric care and reduce risks that could lead to violence on campus.

data.title: BMA to unleash inspectors
data.description: Bangkok will launch its "environmental inspectors" policy across all 50 districts on Nov 1 to strengthen pollution control through joint inspections, standardised checks and year-round monitoring of major pollution sources.

data.title: DSI to review case over ballot QR codes
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will examine a complaint against eight people accused of trying to decode ballot codes in a Bangkok by-election, according to the justice minister.

data.title: Army denies  targeting Preah Vihear
data.description: The Royal Thai Army has rejected Cambodia's claim that Thai attacks damaged Preah Vihear temple, accusing Cambodian forces of using the World Heritage site as a military base.
